categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Jingsong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in intelligent warehousing logistics systems and equipment, including intelligent warehousing, intelligent handling, intelligent distribution, intelligent factories, and system platforms. The company develops and manufactures intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and software, providing integrated solutions for various industries such as automotive, metallurgy, chemical, machinery, textile, electronics, power equipment, and new energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced technologies including AGV (Automated Guided Vehicles), AMR (Autonomous Mobile Robots), 3D vision, SLAM navigation, multi-sensor fusion, AI algorithms, digital twin, and IoT integration. It develops proprietary control systems, mechanical designs for heavy-duty forklifts, shuttle cars, stackers, and sorting systems. Production is order-based with customized design and manufacturing, integrating hardware and software to deliver tailored intelligent logistics solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large enterprises and listed companies in industries such as automotive, chemical, metallurgy, machinery, textile, electronics, power equipment, and new energy. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on heavy manufacturing sectors undergoing intelligent transformation. Major customers include China Energy Construction Group Jiangsu Electric Power Design Institute and other industrial clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province. It has established AGV business units across major Chinese cities including Guangzhou, Chengdu, Shenyang, Hangzhou, Jinan, and Zhengzhou. The company is also actively expanding into international markets, participating in overseas logistics exhibitions and optimizing its overseas marketing teams.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jingsong Intelligent operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and systems. It provides end-to-end solutions including hardware production, software development, system integration, project implementation, and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in intelligent warehousing logistics, with significant R&D investment in AGV and AMR technologies, multi-sensor fusion, AI-driven perception and navigation, digital twin platforms, and cloud-based IoT management. It emphasizes industry-focused solutions for heavy manufacturing sectors and aims to enhance system integration capabilities, expand global market presence, and develop flexible, customized intelligent logistics solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and integrated systems, including hardware and software. The company follows an order-based production model with staged payments: advance payment, shipment payment, acceptance payment, and warranty retention. It also provides after-sales services and system upgrades, contributing to recurring revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jingsong Intelligent is a leading domestic provider of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and systems in China, recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'Little Giant' enterprise. It holds a competitive position with advanced proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. The company faces competition from both domestic and international intelligent logistics equipment manufacturers but maintains advantages through innovation, customization, and comprehensive service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 836 million, a 25.75% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 42.9 million, a 1.48% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.72 billion, up 12.28%, and shareholders' equity was RMB 841 million, up 5.04%. The company has shown steady growth with increasing R&D investment accounting for 8.38% of revenue and maintains a positive cash position despite negative operating cash flow due to increased payables and investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jingsong Intelligent emphasizes its comprehensive, customizable intelligent warehousing logistics solutions that integrate advanced robotics, AI, and digital twin technologies to significantly improve logistics efficiency, reduce labor costs, and optimize warehouse space utilization. Its proprietary AGV and AMR technologies offer high precision, safety, and adaptability in complex industrial environments. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and full lifecycle service model differentiate it as a trusted partner for intelligent logistics transformation.
